title: SREV-071 IPC async start handoff contract

payload.description: Four-slot async handoff payload allocated before CreateThread

thread.description: CreateThread worker handle and success gate

fallback.description: Synchronous wait and cleanup path when async handoff cannot be transferred

contracts: CreateThread returns a thread handle on success and NULL on failure
The async payload may be written only after Dll_AllocTemp returns non-null
The async worker owns hServerEvent and hServerProcess only after CreateThread succeeds
If CreateThread fails after payload allocation, the payload must be freed by the current call
If async handoff cannot be transferred, the current call must fall back to the synchronous wait and cleanup path
The synchronous wait path owns closing hServerEvent and hServerProcess
